key_findings.calgary: 23,178 rows. Name + address + status(7) + licence_id + first_iss_dt all 100% filled. Date range 2001–2026/09/21. No postal/phone/email/NAICS.
key_findings.edmonton: 43,719 rows — largest dataset. Name 100%, address 99.9%, licence_id 100%, original_issue_date 94.2%. Latest date 2025/12/31 — not yet showing 2026 in this field. No status field in schema. No postal/phone/email/NAICS.
key_findings.vancouver: 206,024 rows updated 2026-10-01. Best field set: name 93.4%, address(street) 53.7%, postal 53.4%, status 100%(5 values: Issued/Pending/Gone Out of Business/Inactive/Cancelled), licence_id 100%, issueddate 86.1%. numberofemployees 100% filled as float-strings (e.g. '385.0') — bucket distribution pending. No phone/email/NAICS.
key_findings.winnipeg: 13,757 rows including historical. Name 100% but only 275 unique values (licence-grain). Address only 20.2% filled. No postal/licence_id/NAICS. Status 10 values. Date range 2011–2025/12/31.

phase_14_4_odbus_vs_current.employee_count_finding: Vancouver numberofemployees: 100% populated, stored as float-strings not integers. Parseable as int(float(v)). Bucket distribution not yet computed. Semantic question open: location-level or company-level employees.
phase_14_4_odbus_vs_current.odbus_direct_comparison: ODBus_Sources.csv not in data/raw/ — row-count delta not computed. Current source row counts are the production baseline.
phase_14_4_odbus_vs_current.freshness_gain_confirmed: All four sources have 2025-2026 data vs ODBus 2022 snapshot. Calgary confirmed 2026/09/21. Vancouver confirmed 2026-10-01. Edmonton and Winnipeg latest dates show 2025/12/31 in original_issue_date/issue_date fields but portals confirmed live.

phase_14_4_odbus_vs_current: ODBus is a source-discovery index, not a production dataset. Its 69 source URLs identified current, moved, dead, restricted, and migrated portals. Production pipeline should ingest directly from current source endpoints. Vancouver is the highest-value confirmed source (206k rows, postal code, employee count, updated daily). Calgary and Edmonton are Tier A discovery sources. Winnipeg is the only confirmed MB municipal source.
